name: ling-3.2-flash
description: Ling-3.2-flash is Ant Ling’s latest-generation native multimodal model, with 560B total parameters and 25B active parameters. Designed for complex real-world tasks, it strengthens four core capabilities: complex visual understanding, long-horizon multimodal agents, 3D understanding and interaction, and medical multimodal intelligence. The model tightly integrates multimodal perception, deep reasoning, and autonomous execution.
zhDescription: Ling-3.2-flash 是百灵最新一代原生多模态模型，拥有 560B 总参数、25B 激活参数。模型面向真实场景中的复杂任务，重点强化复杂视觉理解、多模态长程 Agent、3D 理解与交互、医疗多模态四大能力，将多模态感知、深度推理与自主执行紧密结合。
